# btp_update_global_account (Action)

Updates the settings of the global account.

At least one of `display_name`, `description`, or `enable_subaccount_force_deletion` must be specified.

__Tip:__
You must be assigned to the global account admin role.

__Further documentation:__
<https://help.sap.com/docs/btp/btp-cli-command-reference/btp-update-accounts-global-account>

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "btp_update_global_account" "update" {
  config {
    display_name                     = "My Global Account"
    description                      = "Global account for managing SAP BTP resources across all subaccounts"
    enable_subaccount_force_deletion = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) The new description of the global account.
- `display_name` (String) The new display name of the global account.
- `enable_subaccount_force_deletion` (Boolean) Enables or disables the force-deletion of subaccounts in the global account.
